title: WatchlistTriggerPayload
description: A single armed watchlist trigger derived from a parsed daily watchlist line and emitted toward the trigger-strategy workflow. Carries the underlying ticker, the price-trigger (direction + level), and the (strike, right) option tuple to enter on breakout/retest — NOT the resolved OCC option symbol (composed downstream). Reference: docs/plans/PLAN-watchlist-trigger.html.

schema_version.description: DTO contract version. See CopytradeSignalPayload.schema_version. Start at 1; bump on non-backward-compatible field changes.

tenant_id.description: Tenant scope key. Required on every Activity payload and workflow input.

strategy_id.description: Strategy scope key within the tenant.

ticker.description: Underlying equity ticker (e.g. 'AAPL'); uppercase, no exchange suffix. The RAW underlying — not an OCC option symbol. The full OCC symbol is composed downstream from (ticker, et_date-derived expiry, strike, right).

direction.description: Price-trigger direction relative to `trigger`. ABOVE fires when the underlying trades above the level (breakout); BELOW fires when it trades below (breakdown).

trigger.description: Underlying price level (dollars) that arms/fires the entry per `direction`.

right.description: Option right: Call or Put. UPPERCASE.

action.description: Author intent. Watchlist triggers are entries only: buy-to-open.

et_date.description: ET calendar date of the watchlist (YYYY-MM-DD). The America/New_York wall-clock date the trigger belongs to — NOT a timestamp. Named et_date (not date) to avoid shadowing the date type in generated models.

source_message_id.description: Discord message id the watchlist line was parsed from; the dedupe provenance.
